scene ocean
I walk in a strange pattern to avoid the introduction of sand to the insides of my shoes.
lines.zh: 我用一种奇怪的姿势走着，免得沙子跑进鞋子里。

lines.en: It’s one of the least satisfying sensations of all.
lines.zh: 那是最不让人满意的感觉之一。

lines.en: I’m not quite sure where Molly ran off to, but I can only assume that it was somewhere to hide her tears.
lines.zh: 我不太确定 Molly 跑哪儿去了，但只能猜她是找地方藏眼泪去了。

lines.en: Perhaps a linen closet or the arms of a close friend.
lines.zh: 也许是某个布草间，或是某个亲密朋友的怀抱。

lines.en: A close friend other than Rin, that is- since I imagine Molly’s currently fighting back her desire to at least attempt tongue wrestling her before she has the chance to have her heart broken later.
lines.zh: 当然是除 Rin 以外的亲密朋友——因为我想 Molly 这会儿正拼命压住自己至少要去和她舌吻一番的冲动，赶在她稍后有机会心碎之前。

lines.en: I become slightly erect at the thought of the two of them kissing.
lines.zh: 一想到她们两个接吻，我就有点硬了。

lines.en: Then become completely erect at the thought of Otoha joining in.
lines.zh: 再想到 Otoha 也加入进来，就彻底硬了。

lines.en: Then somehow less erect when I add myself into the mix.
lines.zh: 可把自己也加进去之后，反倒没那么硬了。

lines.en: But that’s probably due to the fact that, at that point, it would become less of a pleasurable act and more of a test to see how I’d handle things in that situation.
lines.zh: 大概是因为到了那一步，它就不再是件享乐的事，而更像一场考验——看我在那种情况下能怎么应对。

lines.en: It seems like too much to focus on and would likely detract from the activity.
lines.zh: 要顾的东西太多，反而会败兴。

lines.en: It’s not like any of those girls would prioritize me anyway, so this is one of the worst fantasies I could have concocted during this spur of the moment stroll down soon-to-be-memory lane.
lines.zh: 反正那些女生也不会把我放在第一位，所以这算是我在这趟即将成为回忆的即兴漫步中，能想出来的最烂的幻想之一了。

lines.en: At least it’s getting a little warmer, though.
lines.zh: 不过至少天暖和了一点。

lines.en: Which is strange given the fact that it’s getting later in the day and the tint of the sky has not changed even the slightest.
lines.zh: 这很奇怪，因为天色已晚，而天空的颜色却一点都没变。

lines.en: Kumon-mi is weird. Weather is weird.
lines.zh: Kumon-mi 很怪。天气很怪。

lines.en: Everything is weird. Everyone is weird.
lines.zh: 一切都很怪。每个人都很怪。

lines.en: I keep walking until I find someone less weird.
lines.zh: 我继续走，直到找到一个没那么怪的人。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty1
Or at least that was the plan.
lines.zh: 至少原本是这么打算的。

lines.en: Despite how many similarities I share with the character before me, I’d be a fool to not throw her into the “weird” category with...basically everyone else.
lines.zh: 尽管我和眼前这个角色有不少相似之处，但我要是不把她和……基本上其他所有人一起扔进「怪」那一类，那我就是傻子。

lines.en: Which essentially means I’d have to lump myself in there with her-
lines.zh: 这基本上意味着我也得把自己跟她归到一块儿——

lines.en: But I guess I’m not opposed to being locked in a confined space with a girl like her when she’d likely only require some light coercion to jerk me off in a public bathroom.
lines.zh: 不过我想，我也不排斥和这样的女孩被关在一个狭小空间里——毕竟大概只要稍微使点手段，她就愿意在公共洗手间里帮我打出来。

lines.en: : Are you preparing to mount me, Sensei?

lines.en: : Also, your loyal helper seemed quite opposed to the idea.

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty2
: Are you the type who likes being challenged from time to time?
lines.zh: ：您是那种时不时喜欢被挑战一下的人吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: ：不太是，不是。

lines.en: : I didn’t think so.
lines.zh: ：我想也是。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty1

lines.zh: ：是什么风把您吹到这儿来的？

lines.en: : I half expected you to be fist deep inside of my roommate by now, knowing your powers of seduction.
lines.zh: ：我还多少料到，以您的诱惑之术，这会儿您怕是已经整条手臂都探进我室友的身子里了。

lines.zh: ：你是对所有人都怀着性趣吗？还是……

lines.zh: ：说到底，我依然没有任何真正意义上的性经验。

lines.zh: ：我只是个相当好奇的女孩，对新鲜事有着永远填不满的胃口。

lines.en: : Then I’d like to propose that the two of us venture forth to a public bathroom and I put an earlier thought of mine to the test.

lines.zh: ：没有可用的清洁工储物间吗？

lines.zh: ：只要我们够努力，肯定能找到一个。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty2
: Oh dear. Any more of that and I’ll have to change my underwear.
lines.zh: ：哎呀。再多说一点，我就得去换内裤了。

lines.en: : Can I take your sarcasm as a yes? Or are you going to send me wandering down the beach walking in an even stranger fashion than I’ve already been walking in?
lines.zh: ：我能把你的讽刺当成「好」吗？还是说你要让我沿着海滩以比现在更奇怪的姿势游荡下去？

lines.en: : Are you afraid of the sensation of sand in your shoes as well?
lines.zh: ：您也害怕鞋子里进沙子的感觉吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say I’m afraid. It just kind of sucks.
lines.zh: ：倒不是说害怕。就是挺糟心的。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: ：原来如此。

lines.en: : I suppose I could stop reading and go on a bit of a journey with you.
lines.zh: ：我想我可以放下书，陪您走一小段路。

lines.en: : Though, something tells me that our first true sexual exploit as a duo is a bit further off.
lines.zh: ：不过，我有种直觉，我们作为一对搭档的第一次真正意义上的性冒险，还要再往后排一排。

lines.en: : I feel like we can very easily change that if we’re both up for it.
lines.zh: ：我觉得只要我们俩都愿意，这点很容易就能改变。

lines.en: : Can we?
lines.zh: ：是吗？

lines.en: : Is fate truly something so moldable? Or are you the type to believe that it follows a pre-ordained chain of events to some extent?
lines.zh: ：命运真的那么容易被捏塑吗？还是说您是那种相信它在某种程度上遵循着一条预先注定的事件链的人？

lines.en: : I really don’t care. I just want to have sex.
lines.zh: ：我真的不在乎。我只想做爱。

lines.en: : With me?
lines.zh: ：和我？

lines.en: : Yes, Nodoka.
lines.zh: ：对，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Why is that?
lines.zh: ：为什么呢？

lines.en: : Because I find you attractive and think you’d be fun to have sex with. What more do you want?
lines.zh: ：因为我觉得你很有魅力，而且觉得和你做爱会很有意思。你还想要什么？

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty3
: Did you know that in ancient times, it wasn’t uncommon for men to be romantically involved with both men and women?
lines.zh: ：您知道吗，在古代，男人同时与男人和女人恋爱并不罕见。

lines.en: : And while many of the male on male relationships were sexually exploitative in nature, they weren’t exactly frowned upon until much later when it started becoming a little more...well known.
lines.zh: ：而且尽管许多男性之间的关系在本质上带有性剥削的色彩，但它们直到很久以后、当这种事开始变得……更广为人知时，才真正被人皱眉以对。

lines.en: : Women, however, were never as open to the prospect of bedding other women as they were deemed further away from godliness than that of a man.
lines.zh: ：然而女性从未像男性那样乐于接受与同性共寝的可能，因为她们被认为比男人离神性更远。

lines.en: : I think one of the reasons so many women are sexually experimental and more open to the prospect of fingering each other now than they used to be is that they’re making up for lost time.
lines.zh: ：我觉得现在这么多女性愿意在性上尝试、也比过去更乐于互相用手探索，其中一个原因是她们在弥补失去的时间。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: No.
lines.zh: ：不行。

lines.en: : But we can take a walk if you’d like.
lines.zh: ：不过您要是愿意，我们可以去走走。

lines.en: : I don’t understand you.
lines.zh: ：我真搞不懂你。

lines.en: : Of course you do. You just aren’t used to having to confront someone so philosophically identical.
lines.zh: ：您当然懂。您只是不习惯面对一个在哲学上和您如此相同的人。

lines.en: : What joy would there be in using now as our first experience with one another when now seems like such a standard and unexciting choice?
lines.zh: ：当「现在」显得如此标准、如此无趣的时候，拿它当我们的第一次，又能有什么乐趣？

lines.en: : Wouldn’t something like that proceed to skew our sexual perception of one another to the point where we no longer want to have sex under standard conditions?
lines.zh: ：那样做难道不会把我们对彼此的性认知扭曲到——在正常条件下我们反而不想做爱了的地步吗？

lines.en: : I’m playing the long game here, Sensei.
lines.zh: ：我在打的是持久战，Sensei。

lines.en: : Also, you have not accumulated anywhere near the correct amount of Nodoka points.
lines.zh: ：另外，您积累的 Nodoka 点数还差得远呢。

lines.en: : There is a high price on my V-card, good sir.
lines.zh: ：我这张 V 卡可是明码标价的，好先生。

lines.en: In some ways, Nodoka is even worse than Uta when it comes to teases like this.
lines.zh: 从某些方面来说，Nodoka 在这种挑逗上比 Uta 还过分。

lines.en: But that’s because Nodoka’s obnoxious enough to make it seem like it’s actually a feasible possibility before going off on tangents of...bisexual history or whatever point she was trying to get across just now.
lines.zh: 但那是因为 Nodoka 讨厌到会先让你觉得这事真的可行，然后再岔开话题聊什么……双性恋史，或者她刚才想表达的任何观点。

lines.en: And yet, I’m still not finding myself annoyed enough to wander off in search of someone more likely to swallow my semen.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，我还没烦到要转身去找个更可能吞下我精液的人。

lines.en: Probably because she’s here now while everyone else is still up in the air- and waiting for any of them to float back down to earth sounds a bit too boring for my liking.
lines.zh: 大概是因为她此刻就在这儿，而其他人都还悬在半空——等着她们中的任何一个飘回地面，听起来对我来说太无聊了。

lines.en: : So, to clarify, you will go on a walk with me...but that walk will not result in any act of intimacy?
lines.zh: ：那么确认一下，你愿意和我去散步……但这场散步不会以任何亲密行为收场？

lines.zh: ：那您想看我[masturbate]吗？

lines.zh: ：你真会做吗？还是说这又是一次人格探测？

lines.en: : Don’t know. Hard to say without seeing where the wind takes us.
lines.zh: ：不知道。不看风把我们吹向哪里，很难说。

lines.en: : You’re so fucking weird.
lines.zh: ：你真他妈的怪。

lines.en: scene black

lines.zh: 尽管她的腿抖得像只新生的小鹿，她还是小心地不让手指从书页里挪开。

lines.en: Using my master level of deductive reasoning, I half-confirm in my mind that this is either an important book to Nodoka or one that she’s reading for the first time.
lines.zh: 凭借我大师级的推理能力，我在心里半确认了一件事：这本书要么对 Nodoka 很重要，要么是她第一次读。

lines.en: Why I’m thinking of this instead of what she looks like underneath the layers of winter clothing, I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我为什么会想这个，而不是想她那层层冬装底下是什么样子，我也不知道。

lines.en: But something inside of me feels compelled to ask.
lines.zh: 可我心里有个什么东西，逼着我去问。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty5
: Nodoka.
lines.zh: ：Nodoka。

lines.en: : Yes, my love?

lines.zh: ：那你要真见的时候，我能参与吗？

lines.zh: ：不是每次都行，但我保证会把不少实验都算上您一份。

lines.zh: ：等等，打住。我被带偏了。我刚才本来要问你件事的。

lines.zh: ：是吗？

lines.zh: ：嗯。就是关于你在读的那本书。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty6
: Oh? I have to say, I’m a bit surprised that you were willing to stray away from the topic at hand when I was certain it was your favorite one.
lines.zh: ：哦？我得说，我挺惊讶您居然愿意离开手边这个话题——我还以为那是您最喜欢的话题呢。

lines.en: : Having an erection is just a burden when I know it won’t end up inside of anyone.
lines.zh: ：既然知道它最后进不了任何人，勃起就只是一种负担。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty7

lines.zh: ：我本来还准备施舍您一次同情手交呢。

lines.zh: ：不过既然进不了我的身体，那就没意义了，我也不费那个事了。

lines.en: : You are my new least favorite student.
lines.zh: ：你现在是我最不喜欢的学生了。

lines.en: : I love you too, darling.
lines.zh: ：我也爱您，亲爱的。

lines.en: : What I’m reading today isn’t all that exciting, though.
lines.zh: ：不过我今天读的这本，其实也没那么精彩。

lines.en: : It’s just a collection of short stories I’m rereading for my own personal reasons.
lines.zh: ：只是一本短篇集，我因为一些私人原因在重读。

lines.en: : Ah.
: Well, I don’t know much about short stories, so I think this topic is going to fall flat.
lines.zh: ：嗯，我对短篇了解不多，所以这个话题大概聊不下去。

lines.en: : I’d highly recommend this one if you’re ever looking to kill six thousand words worth of time.
lines.zh: ：要是哪天您想打发掉六千字的时间，我强烈推荐这一篇。

lines.en: : And what is “this one?”
lines.zh: ：那「这一篇」是什么？

lines.en: : The story of a girl forced to spend an unhealthy amount of time confined to a single location.
lines.zh: ：讲的是一个女孩被迫在一个地方待了太久太久，久到不正常。

lines.en: : The onset of hysteria and how isolation itself can be just as deadly a beast as cancer.
lines.zh: ：讲歇斯底里是怎么发作的，以及孤独本身如何能像癌症一样成为致命的野兽。

lines.en: : It’s called “The Yellow Wallpaper.”
lines.zh: ：它叫《黄色墙纸》。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty8
: How do you think you’d fare in a situation like that, Sensei?
lines.zh: ：您觉得要是处在那种境地，您会怎么样，Sensei？

lines.en: : Being trapped, I mean.
lines.zh: ：我是说，被困住。

lines.en: : Stuck in one place...unable to venture outside of it.
lines.zh: ：卡在一个地方……没法走出去。

lines.en: : That’s not really an easy question.
lines.zh: ：这可不是个容易回答的问题。

lines.en: : I suppose it isn’t.
lines.zh: ：我想也是。

lines.en: : Why, that sounds quite familiar to our current situation, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: ：哎呀，这听起来跟我们的处境相当相似，不是吗？

lines.en: : If we can not leave Kumon-mi, how can we even confirm if there is a world outside of it?
lines.zh: ：如果我们离不开 Kumon-mi，那我们又怎么能确认外面还有一个世界？

lines.en: : I mean, several of the girls have parents outside of Kumon-mi that they’re in regular contact with. Isn’t that confirmation enough?
lines.zh: ：我是说，有几个女生的父母就在 Kumon-mi 外面，而且她们一直保持联系。这还不够确认吗？

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty9
: For some, that would be enough. Yes.
lines.zh: ：对有些人来说，那足够了。是的。

lines.en: : Though, I’m the type of person who has trouble believing anything if I do not see it with my own eyes.
lines.zh: ：不过，我是那种不亲眼看见就很难相信任何事的人。

lines.en: : The curse of being a curious realist, I suppose.
lines.zh: ：大概这就是当一个好奇的现实主义者的诅咒吧。

lines.en: : If someone is trapped...the most realistic reaction would be for them to attempt to escape, yes?
lines.zh: ：如果有人被困住了……最现实的反应应该是设法逃出去，对吧？

lines.en: : And yet some people give up on that entirely.
lines.zh: ：可有些人却彻底放弃了。

lines.en: : They fall victim to circumstance and let a horrible reality overtake them when they’re feeling too weak to compete.
lines.zh: ：他们成了境遇的牺牲品，在软弱到无力抗争的时候，任由一个可怕的现实吞噬自己。

lines.en: : ‘Tis a shame I tell you.
lines.zh: ：我跟您说，这真是件憾事。

lines.en: : A god damn fucking shame.
lines.zh: ：真他妈的可惜。

lines.en: Nodoka falls silent for a moment and I can’t really find anything worth adding to the conversation.
lines.zh: Nodoka 沉默了片刻，而我也实在找不出什么值得补充进这场对话的话。

lines.en: Even though her story sounds interesting by...short story standards, six thousand words is still time I could be using to crank one out or...asking one of the girls for nudes.
lines.zh: 尽管以……短篇小说的标准来看，她讲的故事听起来挺有意思，可六千字的时间，我还是可以用来打一发，或者……找某个女生要裸照。

lines.en: : Do you have your own room this weekend, Sensei?
lines.zh: ：这周末您有自己的房间吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I do.
scene nodokaispretty10
: May I see it?
lines.zh: ：我能去看看吗？

lines.en: : Do you actually want to see it or are you just fucking with me?
lines.zh: ：你是真想看，还是在耍我？

lines.en: : Why would I be fucking with you?
lines.zh: ：我为什么要耍您？

lines.en: if futabalust15 == True:
: I accompanied you to your room during the dorm war and that was a resounding success, wouldn’t you say?
lines.zh: ：宿舍大战那会儿我就陪您去过您的房间，而且那次大获成功，您说是不是？

lines.en: else:
: It wouldn’t be the first time you’ve taken me to your room during a class-wide event, would it?
lines.zh: ：这也不是您第一次在全班活动期间带我回您房间了，对吧？

lines.en: : Though, I suppose you might be a little nervous or excited since we’ll be all alone this time.
lines.zh: ：不过，我想这次我们彻底独处，您可能会有点紧张或者兴奋。

lines.en: : I mean, I’m fine with taking you there. I just don’t really know which room is mine, yet.
lines.zh: ：我是说，带你去我没问题。只是我还不知道哪间房是我的。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty9
: Never fear. I may have already gotten that information during a particular strip search earlier.
lines.zh: ：别怕。我可能在早些时候某次脱衣搜查中已经拿到这个情报了。

lines.en: : Your talent is being wasted on all of us, Nodoka.
lines.zh: ：你的才华在我们这些人身上真是浪费了，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Nothing can be called a waste if you have fun in the process.
lines.zh: ：只要过程中玩得开心，就不能叫浪费。

lines.en: : And, Sensei...
lines.zh: ：而且，Sensei……

lines.en: : I’m having a lot of fun all of a sudden.
lines.zh: ：我突然觉得特别开心。

lines.en: scene black
scene nodokaispretty11
: Oh dear god, no.
lines.zh: ：哦，天啊，不要。

lines.en: : Hey, you two. Fancy running into you here.
lines.zh: ：嘿，你们两个。真巧，在这儿碰上了。

lines.en: : I honestly forgot you were even going to be at this thing.
lines.zh: ：说实话，我都忘了你也会来这趟活动。

lines.en: : Thanks, Osako. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: ：谢了，Osako。我很感动。

lines.en: : I was hoping I’d be able to avoid confrontation before going into a self-induced coma for the weekend, but it appears that dream of mine was too good to be true.
lines.zh: ：我本来还指望在自我诱发昏迷、度过这个周末之前能避开一切冲突，看来我这个梦太美好了，根本不现实。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty12
: *Sniff sniff*
lines.zh: ：*嗅嗅*

lines.en: : That subtle scent of lilac and earl grey tea...
lines.zh: ：那股淡淡的紫丁香与伯爵茶的气味……

lines.en: : You...you really are here...
lines.zh: ：你……你真的在这儿……

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhhhhh...
lines.zh: ：呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Do not sniff me, you mischievous wench.
lines.zh: ：别嗅我，你这个不安分的丫头。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty13
: I’m open to threesomes, you know...
lines.zh: ：我对三人行是开放的，您知道的……

lines.en: : I’ll do anything you want me to...
lines.zh: ：您想让我做什么我都愿意……

lines.en: I bite my tongue and manage to prevent myself from scolding Nodoka for being open to hooking up with a female teacher and not me.
lines.zh: 我咬住舌头，总算忍住没去训 Nodoka——她愿意跟一位女老师搞上，却不愿意跟我。

lines.en: Even though Osako already seems to be aware of my relationship with Ayane and...Wakana has her suspicions as well, incriminating myself like that would probably be a death sentence.
lines.zh: 尽管 Osako 似乎已经知道我和 Ayane 的关系，而……Wakana 也有所怀疑，但那样把自己搭进去，大概等于判自己死刑。

lines.en: : Nodoka. Please stop sniffing Wakana.
lines.zh: ：Nodoka。别再嗅 Wakana 了。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty14
: In the event that they would like a fourth participant to even out the numbers, I’d like to rescind my earlier statements regarding the probability of us-
lines.zh: ：万一他们想凑第四个参与者让人数配平，我想撤回我之前关于我们——

lines.en: : Yeah, no. Hold on a second.
lines.zh: ：不不不。等一下。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty15
: That’s my girlfriend you’re...inhaling right now.
lines.zh: ：你现在……吸气闻的那位，是我女朋友。

lines.en: : You touched Miss Watabe without her wincing in disgust.
lines.zh: ：您碰了 Watabe 小姐，而她没有厌恶地退缩。

lines.en: : You two must truly have a deeper connection than I believed at first glance.
lines.zh: ：看来你们两个的联系，比我第一眼以为的要深得多。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty16
: No matter. If you’d prefer to use me as some sort of object or toy instead of an active participant in the bedroom, I’d be open to that as well.
lines.zh: ：没关系。要是你们更愿意把我当个物件或玩具，而不是床上的积极参与者，我也愿意接受。

lines.en: : Osako. Do the...karate to her.
lines.zh: ：Osako。对她用那个……空手道。

lines.en: : It’s not the karate, babe. It’s just karate.
lines.zh: ：不是「那个空手道」，宝贝。就是空手道。

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure I could get arrested for hitting someone her age, so...let’s just get to our room so you can take a nap.
lines.zh: ：而且我敢肯定，打她这个年纪的人会让我被抓起来，所以……我们还是回房间吧，你好睡个午觉。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty17
: Nagasawa, if you attempt to make contact with me even once before the weekend is over, I will poison you in your sleep.
lines.zh: ：Nagasawa，这个周末结束前，你要是敢碰我哪怕一次，我就在你睡着的时候毒死你。

lines.en: : I’m a reeaaaaaally heavy sleeper, Miss Watabe. You could do all sorts of other things to me as well if you wanted and no one would ever know.
lines.zh: ：我睡得可————沉了，Watabe 小姐。您要是愿意，还可以对我做各种别的事，而且永远不会有人知道。

lines.en: : Uhh...hi. And bye, I guess.
lines.zh: ：呃……嗨。那，再见吧。

lines.en: : Please keep your weird pervert friend away from us.
lines.zh: ：请让你那个古怪的变态朋友离我们远点。

lines.en: : I...will do my best.
lines.zh: ：我……会尽力的。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty18
Osako pulls Wakana along and the two of them hastily walk down the halls of the inn to the room where I imagine they’ll be quarantining for the weekend on account of a[school]girl lesbian outbreak.
lines.zh: Osako 拉着 Wakana 走掉，两人匆忙穿过旅馆的走廊，走向那间我想她们会因为一场[school]女同性恋爆发而自我隔离一整个周末的房间。

lines.en: : Huh.
: You know, I’m going to go out on a limb here and assume that if I still had my swimsuit on that none of this painful rejection would have ever happened.
lines.zh: ：您知道吗，我斗胆猜一句：要是我还穿着泳衣，这些令人痛苦的拒绝就一件都不会发生。

lines.en: : I have very nice legs. And now they are missing out on a cute, obedient girl in the prime of her sexuality.
lines.zh: ：我的腿非常好。而现在它们错过了一个正值性欲巅峰、又可爱又听话的女孩。

lines.en: : Nodoka, harness that energy and take it into my room.
lines.zh: ：Nodoka，把那股劲儿收一收，带到我房间里去。

lines.en: scene nodokaispretty19
: But it’s just not the same with a penis.
lines.zh: ：可是带根阴茎的就不是一回事了。

lines.en: : How do you know? You have zero experience.
lines.zh: ：你怎么知道？你一点经验都没有。

lines.en: : Girls are gentle and delicate like flowers, while you are a torrential downpour looking to flood my insides with your seed when all I want is a light shower.
lines.zh: ：女孩像花一样温柔纤细，而您是一场倾盆大雨，一心想用您的种子灌满我的身体，可我想要的只是一场小雨。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: ：什么？
